title: CouponsReportRequest
description: coupons.report-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/coupons/:id/report on OpenVibe.Coupons (coupons.report.create; people, installs and services acting for a person): whether the code worked, and for a failure why. The code must be in active results; you cannot report your own submission. Reporting again changes your earlier report.
